audit_reason: Stated managerial action is SK렌터카 equity/stake sale and business deconsolidation. Lower leverage is a downstream financial consequence; debt principal repayment is not the stated action. One-action DL representation would suppress a material noncanonical asset/business disposal.

KIS explicitly states a plan for conservative vessel investment in response to high vessel prices. This is a prospective investment-restraint mechanism aligned with growth-CAPEX restraint. Used-vessel sales are retained as additional tags but do not erase the explicit investment-restraint statement.

KB Securities explicitly argues that this is likely not an appropriate time for additional vessel investment. The recommendation is directly about deferring growth investment and is therefore aligned with CX.

Issuer release attributes already-realized FY2024 profit improvement to SG&A/cost reduction and process improvement. The evidence is retrospective, not a prospective or ongoing 2024 action recommendation under the strict gate.
Primary Mirae Asset report states that the cost-efficiency stance/policy is expected to continue in 2024 after strong organizational restructuring. This is an ongoing explicit cost-efficiency policy.

Primary Daishin report states that converting own products to LDT will reduce testing-kit cost by up to 90% and reduce logistics cost through network integration. The prospective mechanism is explicit and directly cost-efficiency oriented.

Primary report states that the 2024 surface-treatment automation experience will be applied to Mexico and Poland plants and frames process automation as a profitability-improvement mechanism. Prospective operating-efficiency path is explicit.

Primary Mirae Asset report explicitly says the firm intends to improve production-cost efficiency through casting newer actors and can raise production productivity using generative AI. The prospective cost-efficiency route is explicit.

Primary Eugene report confirms ongoing component internalization, with motor internalization completed and reducer testing underway, and explicitly states that internalization directly reduces cost. The original analyst report was recovered and replaces reliance on automated summaries.

Primary NH report identifies acquisition of an Indonesian smelter and MHP internalization as the managerial strategy, with lower precursor cost as a downstream effect. The acquisition is a material noncanonical investment action; strict OE would suppress that co-action.

Mirae report attributes lower fixed cost partly to prior capacity expansion and higher utilization, then emphasizes continuing CAPA expansion/business expansion. Coding OE alone would suppress a material growth-CAPEX action and mixes retrospective efficiency with prospective expansion.
